<!--
  Customer quotes as cards, plain figures or social posts, in a grid, a masonry, a scroll strip, one featured
  quote or one narrow column. Axes: layout (grid, single, stack, masonry, strip), columns, item kind (card,
  plain, social), item avatar, item rating, item mark (a company glyph), density, tone. A carousel is the
  Carousel port contract around the single layout.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Quote, QuoteLabels, QuoteItem } from "./testimonial-grid.types";

export type TestimonialGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  quotes: Quote[];
  labels: QuoteLabels;
  layout?: "grid" | "single" | "stack" | "masonry" | "strip";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3";
  item?: QuoteItem;
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import QuoteCard from "../components/quote-card.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  quotes,
  labels,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  item,
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<TestimonialGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :align="(((layout as string) === 'single') ? 'center' : 'start')"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'grid') ? 'default' : '2xl')"
  >
    <Block v-if="(((layout as string) === 'masonry') || ((layout as string) === 'strip'))"
      tag="div"
      :class="
        (layout as string) === 'masonry' ? 'columns-1 gap-4 md:columns-2 xl:columns-3'
        : 'flex snap-x gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-2'
      "
      data-testid="items"
    >
      <QuoteCard v-for="q in quotes" :key="q.id" :q="q" :labels="labels" :item="item" :layout="layout" />
    </Block>
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((layout as string) === 'grid') ? cols : '1')" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <template v-for="(q, i) in quotes" :key="q.id">
        <QuoteCard
          v-if="(((layout as string) !== 'single') || (i === 0))"
          :q="q"
          :labels="labels"
          :item="item"
          :layout="layout"
        />
      </template>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
